purpose: The gate definitions every Line Governance frontier must pass before it is accepted and the next opens. Inherited from SOCC's four-gate model, specialized for line governance.

gates.name: Scientific Quality Gate
gates.definition: The decision is evidence-based and falsifiable with an explicit pass/fail. For detection: the PID/session facts are reproducible (pgrep/lsof/ps). For classification & dedup: a numeric, explainable score is shown (similarity %, drift distance) and the threshold is justified, not taste.
fails_if: a decision rests on taste not evidence
a similarity/drift score is hidden or unjustified

gates.name: Hermes Gate (it actually works)
gates.definition: The artifact runs/renders for real: the scanner enumerates real live PIDs, the heartbeat file is written and read back, `socc lines` prints, the control room renders from real JSON.
fails_if: a script is described but does not run
the control room shows mock data
heartbeat is claimed but not written

gates.name: Codex Gate (canon law)
gates.definition: Conforms to SOCC canon: correct file structure & naming under SYSTEM/LINE_GOVERNANCE/, registry/state schemas honored, truth_boundary present on every artifact, and a proof is emitted into SOVEREIGN/PROOF/proof_chain/.
fails_if: live LAWFUL_NEXT route mutated without explicit creator step

gates.name: Guardian (adversarial)
gates.definition: N skeptics try to refute before ACCEPT. They check: no false-positive duplicate, no false-negative (real dup missed), no silent drift, no auto-kill / auto-handoff without consent, every handoff reversible, and that confidence is stated honestly (heuristic is labeled heuristic).
fails_if: a duplicate is asserted without confirmable evidence
a process could be closed without consent
heuristic certainty is dressed up as fact

global_invariants: no daemon, no background loop, no scheduler — event-driven hooks + on-demand CLI only
no kill/signal/auto-close of any process without explicit creator confirmation
no automatic handoff before P4 is accepted; auto-mode opt-in and reversible
no fake PASS, no hidden duplicate, no silent drift, no AGI/revenue claim
the live LAWFUL_NEXT / route_authority is never silently mutated by this organ
truth_boundary: Gate definitions only. Declares how frontiers are judged. Enforces nothing by itself; it is the rubric the Guardian and creator apply at each ACCEPT.
